comments.quote: It was a very nice experience! Me and my husband loved it, so the pets. For the ones looking for a very chill and calm weekend , also not too far from Hangzhou, it is perfect.
comments.author: Dani in China

comments.quote: We arrived at 8pm. The receptionist was friendly and told us how to use the door access control. The room was clean and tidy! It was a very good RV experience. I will stay here again next time.
comments.author: Guest User
